522      async def ensure_stream_run(
  523          self,
  524          context: WorkspaceExecutionContext,
  525          *,
  526          thread_id: UUID,
  527          agent_version_id: UUID,
  528          turn: ThreadTurn,
  529      ) -> PreparedTurnRun:
  530          """Claim and prepare the one streaming Run for a persisted Turn.
  531  
  532          The database Turn row is the claim. Every contender looks up the Run by
  533          ``thread_turn_id``; only the winner that created it streams, and every
  534          retry replays that Run. There is no grace window or time comparison.
  535          """
  536  
  537          if self.run_service is None:
  538              raise AgentHubError("DATABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED", "Runs are not configured.", 503)
  539          existing = await self._turn_run(context, thread_id, turn)
  540          if existing is not None:
  541              if turn.agent_run_id is None:
  542                  await self.attach_run(context, turn_id=turn.id, run_id=existing.id)
  543                  turn.agent_run_id = existing.id
  544              return PreparedTurnRun(
  545                  turn=turn,
  546                  run_id=existing.id,
  547                  run=existing if self._is_unstarted_run(existing) else None,
  548                  reused=True,
  549              )
  550          try:
  551              prepared = await self.run_service.prepare_stream(
  552                  context,
  553                  agent_version_id=agent_version_id,
  554                  input_text=turn.user_input,
  555                  thread_id=thread_id,
  556                  thread_turn_id=turn.id,
  557              )
  558          except IntegrityError as error:
  559              winner = await self._winner_after_run_conflict(
  560                  context,
  561                  thread_id=thread_id,
  562                  turn=turn,
  563                  error=error,
  564              )
  565              await self.attach_run(context, turn_id=turn.id, run_id=winner.id)
  566              turn.agent_run_id = winner.id
  567              return PreparedTurnRun(
  568                  turn=turn,
  569                  run_id=winner.id,
  570                  run=winner if self._is_unstarted_run(winner) else None,
  571                  reused=True,
  572              )
  573          await self.attach_run(context, turn_id=turn.id, run_id=prepared.id)
  574          turn.agent_run_id = prepared.id
  575          return PreparedTurnRun(
  576              turn=turn,
  577              run_id=prepared.id,
  578              run=prepared,
  579              reused=False,
  580          )

  130      if not isinstance(resolved_spec, Mapping):
  131          raise _invalid_binding()
  132      schema_version = resolved_spec.get("spec_schema_version")
  133      if (
  134          isinstance(schema_version, bool)
  135          or not isinstance(schema_version, int)
  136          or schema_version not in SUPPORTED_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSIONS
  137      ):
  138          raise _invalid_binding()
  139      model = resolved_spec.get("model")
  140      prompt = resolved_spec.get("prompt")
  141      if not isinstance(model, Mapping) or not isinstance(prompt, Mapping):
  142          raise _invalid_binding()
  143      primary = _parse_profile(model, workspace_id=workspace_id, primary=True)
  144      fallback_values = model.get("fallback_profiles", [])

  146          raise _invalid_binding()
  147      fallbacks = tuple(
  148          _parse_profile(item, workspace_id=workspace_id, primary=False) for item in fallback_values
  149      )
  150      retry_value = model.get("retry_policy", {"max_attempts": 1})
  151      if not isinstance(retry_value, Mapping):
  152          raise _invalid_binding()
  153      try:
  154          retry_policy = RetryPolicy(max_attempts=int(retry_value.get("max_attempts", 1)))
  155      except (TypeError, ValueError):
  156          raise _invalid_binding() from None

  158      prompt_version = prompt.get("prompt_version", prompt.get("version", 1))

492      async def sources(self, session, context, row, require_current=False, share_lock=False):
  493          snapshot = await KnowledgeSnapshotService().resolve_snapshot(
  494              session, context, row.knowledge_base_id, row.source_snapshot_id
  495          )
  496          if snapshot.content_hash != row.source_snapshot_hash:
  497              fail("WIKI_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH", "The Wiki source snapshot has changed.")
  498          items = list(
  499              await session.scalars(
  500                  select(KnowledgeSnapshotItem.document_revision_id).where(
  501                      KnowledgeSnapshotItem.workspace_id == row.workspace_id,
  502                      KnowledgeSnapshotItem.snapshot_id == row.source_snapshot_id,
  503                      KnowledgeSnapshotItem.knowledge_base_id == row.knowledge_base_id,
  504                  )
  505              )
  506          )
  507          all_members = set(items)
  508          exclusions = {UUID(value) for value in row.compiler_spec.get("excluded_revision_ids", [])}
  509          if not exclusions.issubset(all_members):
  510              fail("WIKI_SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID", "The frozen Wiki source scope is invalid.")
  511          revoked = set(
  512              await session.scalars(
  513                  select(WikiSourceRevocation.document_revision_id).where(
  514                      WikiSourceRevocation.workspace_id == row.workspace_id,
  515                      WikiSourceRevocation.knowledge_base_id == row.knowledge_base_id,
  516                  )
  517              )
  518          )
  519          if (revoked & all_members) - exclusions:
  520              fail("WIKI_SOURCE_REVOKED", "A Wiki source has been permanently revoked.")
  521          items = [value for value in items if value not in exclusions]
  522          rev_query = select(DocumentRevision).where(
  523              DocumentRevision.workspace_id == row.workspace_id,
  524              DocumentRevision.knowledge_base_id == row.knowledge_base_id,
  525              DocumentRevision.id.in_(items),
  526          )
  527          if share_lock:
  528              rev_query = rev_query.with_for_update(read=True)
  529          revisions = list(await session.scalars(rev_query))
  530          if len(items) != len(revisions) or any(
  531              r.lifecycle_status == "DELETED" or r.ingestion_status != "READY" for r in revisions
  532          ):
  533              fail("WIKI_SOURCE_REVOKED", "A Wiki source is unavailable or revoked.")
  534          if require_current:
  535              current = await KnowledgeSnapshotService()._current_revisions(
  536                  session, row.workspace_id, row.knowledge_base_id
  537              )
  538              superseded = await session.scalar(
  539                  select(Document.id)
  540                  .where(
  541                      Document.workspace_id == row.workspace_id,
  542                      Document.knowledge_base_id == row.knowledge_base_id,
  543                      Document.id.in_([r.document_id for r in revisions]),
  544                      Document.superseded_by_document_id.is_not(None),
  545                  )
  546                  .limit(1)
  547              )
  548              if set(items) != ({r.id for r in current} - revoked) or superseded:
  549                  fail("WIKI_STALE", "Sources changed; compile and publish a new Wiki version.")
  550          return revisions
